opening.argument: The video is principally a practical Wells Fargo debit-card tutorial: its title identifies activation as the subject, and the speaker explains that viewers will learn “3 different ways to activate your debit card,” including activation through an ATM. The online discussion does show Username and Password fields beside activation materials, and it describes entering a name and password to access the account. But those facts do not establish that the page is fraudulent or that any credentials were submitted. The separate Cash App message says, “Try Cash App using my code and we’ll each get $5! SFGQXGB,” yet it is not explicitly connected to the activation instructions and is not shown to have produced a reward. The evidence therefore supports an operational demonstration with an unproven promotional aside.
